dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Ocular myasthenia gravis (autoimmune, anti-AChR antibody–mediated postsynaptic neuromuscular junction disorder, isolated to the extraocular muscles and levator palpebrae)

Alternatives:
1. Botulism (presynaptic neuromuscular junction blockade from Clostridium botulinum toxin)
2. Mitochondrial chronic progressive external ophthalmoplegia (CPEO) with ptosis
3. Cavernous sinus syndrome (e.g., granulomatous or neoplastic infiltration) below the resolution of contrast MRI
